preconditions: Roadmap at approved IA work item; explicit owner approval; current repos clean/understood; source backups verified
action: Verify handoff package, source hashes, current schemas, and feature flag default-off contract.
exit_gate: All preconditions recorded; no production data changed.

action: Snapshot canonical catalogs/data; record checksums/counts; create migration audit storage.
exit_gate: Restore-tested snapshot and immutable pre-migration fingerprint.
rollback: Remove audit scaffolding only after evidence export; canonical data untouched.

action: Create new registries/tables/collections/indices with nullable/non-required links; no current schema field removal.
exit_gate: Existing app behavior/tests unchanged with feature disabled.
rollback: Drop only new empty structures if needed.

action: Load platform/creator/lineage/market/asset controlled vocabularies using stable IDs.
exit_gate: Registry validators pass; Skiff boundary validator active in shadow mode.
rollback: Delete seeded registry rows by migration batch ID.

action: Project current catalog records into new model/assignment structures without altering source rows.
exit_gate: All source IDs/counts/hashes preserved; unresolved mappings remain review-required.

phase: Import provenance and legacy recovery evidence
action: Load legacy source occurrences, concept seeds, crosswalk evidence, and re-mechanization queue.
exit_gate: Legacy mechanics flagged non-authoritative; 1 unresolved concept remains unresolved unless separately reviewed.
rollback: Delete imported derived evidence/work queue; source archives untouched.

action: Run validators against new projections and compare with existing runtime/catalog behavior.
exit_gate: No critical validator failures; no unintended behavior diff.

preconditions: IA-6 pass; review queue threshold approved
action: Approve selected taxonomy and creator mappings; expose read-only filtering/inspection behind feature flag.
exit_gate: Search/filter provenance correct; current genre/manufacturer strings still preserved.
rollback: Disable feature; revoke/soft-retire derived approvals, preserving audit.

action: Adopt reviewed family/platform/model/variant/trim relationships without changing existing product IDs.
exit_gate: No automatic merges; lineage graph validators pass.
rollback: Disable lineage UI; soft-retire relationship batch.

action: Add production history, market context, service/parts support, and factory configurations where evidence exists.
exit_gate: No price-authority conflicts; context-sensitive values never overwrite global current fields.

preconditions: IA-9 pass; current mechanics anchors verified
action: Process candidate queue using current rules; preserve concept/provenance; peer-compare and validate.
exit_gate: Each published concept passes all re-mechanization acceptance gates.
rollback: Unpublish/revert only newly created governed revisions; legacy evidence retained.

preconditions: IA-10 stable; runtime ownership/inventory/event dependencies ready
action: Enable creation of individual assets pinned to product spec versions and governed runtime history.
rollback: Feature flag off; retain asset data read-only for recovery/export unless explicit destructive rollback approved.

preconditions: Sustained production evidence and owner approval
action: Decide whether old display fields remain indefinitely, become derived aliases, or are deprecated.
exit_gate: No source/provenance loss; migrations remain reversible.
rollback: Keep legacy fields; this phase may be skipped permanently.
